steps.name: Girl's Memories (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Dana] in “Guild City Esnil”, defeat [Eda] in “Dreaming Oneiro” and obtain <Eda’s Old Ribbon>. Then report to [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh, busy. I'm busy. Hey, Mr. %s… . Weren't you resting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was resting at an inn and something came to mind, so I came.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did you come here because you wanted to talk about our sisters?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. This is not the story of Dana's sisters.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah? thank you. Hehe, I really don't like receiving unnecessary attention.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, shall I guess? What is %s thinking... . I'm worried about that girl I met in Oneiro Forest!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did you say Eda…? ? I saw it too. I went there once for work... . The girl with the golem looked ordinary... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: When Mr. %s looked, there was something like a witch's arm hanging on the girl's back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bergelmir said that the child was freed from the curse when he died. And thank you for helping the man named Shinik and destroying Ixion.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I guess it's a story about the Eastern Continent. I don't know much about that, sorry. I know that %s meets superhumans from the Eastern Continent, but... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, Shinick was one of the superhumans, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: To Shinick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I guess I can't go right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Good idea. Then we should go to Oneiro Forest first, right? It is said that the wizards of the Union of Light and the Sylvaria Empire have purified Oneiro Forest, so nothing major will happen.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There may be evidence they haven't seen, so take a look.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I know because I felt it last time, right? People like %s who visit that place once can quickly find it again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What to do with it... . Don't be too confident though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go then, Mr. Dana... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Zelic, are you here?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: President, you are there. Coincidentally, new bread came out so I brought it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thanks, that worked out just fine. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Just in case, follow %s. Help me if something dangerous happens. Please report back to me later on what's going on.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: If that's the case, I'll go right away. Hmm… . I have to bring this to Raclette too... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Raclette, he doesn't even eat properly. Just give me everything. I will eat everything with Narsha. So come quickly. Okay?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Okay, leader.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: On days when you're bored and need a friend, should you at least make a friend doll using magic? Ugh, I’m bored… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, how about going for a quick run?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Running is a hassle! I hate sweating!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: In the past, I heard that you enjoyed running up to the barrier in Kali Village and jumping out of it. How about that?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, that's fun! however… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Medea will probably hate it, right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Of course not. Even so, you must have been very uncomfortable because of what happened with %s last time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Huh? Hey %s… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Should I make fun of you? Because he's fun to tease... . Melvik, pretend not to know me. Because he's hiding over there.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, Shinik. I hope you have fun.
(Shynic hides behind the building and pops forward in a cat-like pose when %s is visible.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ahhh♡!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what a surprise!! Uh, what is eoheung again?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There's a saying like that. Somewhere it is said that even tigers appear when you talk about them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that tiger.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah, boring reaction… . (Should I kill him?) (Muttering) I think something happened... . what? Is there anything fun happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I just heard something dangerous... , first look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give Shinik the old ribbon found in Oneiro Forest.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is this… ?
(Shynick accepts the ribbon and cannot say anything.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, no way… . It must be a coincidence. This ribbon... .
(Shaynick unties the ribbon that tied his hair and compares it with the ribbon in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: To my beloved Shinik… . To my beloved Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, where did you get this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Shinik that you saw a girl named Eda in Oneiro Forest. Then tell him what happened.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eda… ? Eda?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … Eda, Eda... . gouge… .
(Shaynick collapses while calling Eda's name. Shaynick's condition seems strange. It's like he's in a panic...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik!! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ugh… … . eww… … . Me, I'm fine... .
(Shaynick falls unconscious. Melvik, startled, picks up Shaynick and hurries to take her to her room.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened to make it like that... ?
(After a while, Melvik appears in front of %s. He looks very worried.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: For now, Shinik has regained his stability... .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It seems like you are having a hard time because of past memories. Memories that bother Shinik... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , what should I do in this situation?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask you. First of all, could you explain the situation to Mediah and ask for help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think it's because of me, so I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then I'll ask you a favor. In the meantime, I will be taking a look at Shinik.

steps.name: Girl's Memories (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] at “God’s Tree, Lapier” and obtain <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you. The energy of the wind heading towards Tartarus has changed... . Is this by any chance Shineek?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much do you know, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Just feel it, you don't have to think about it complicatedly. Now, let's talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If so... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Medea what happened to Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Something like that happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know Shinik would react like that. I never thought the girl in Oneiro Forest would have something like that... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are mistaken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We are human. Although they only have special powers that are different from those of ordinary people. Yes, that power… . It is both a blessing and a curse.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And recognizing that a being that cannot be perfect is perfect... , that is the mistake that ordinary people, including you, make.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You don't have to apologize to me. It's just a weakness that humans have. When Shinik wakes up later, explain the situation.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: First, let me make a medicine that will help Shinik.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah… . I don't have any ingredients.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get it for you. Where can I get it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I can't help it. Get the Seed of Illusion from Lapier. It is different from the illusion tree seeds that Tractus have.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It must be hard to find because it is a rarely seen material... . Still, I think you will come.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, you've seen a different side of the world. It's probably a place you can't normally go to... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . It just so happened… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That will be your path.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will find it and come back as soon as possible. wait for me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, of course... .

steps.name: Girl's Memories (4)
steps.objective: Go to [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are here. What about rapier?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's similar to when I went before. There was no particularly ominous energy.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Could you please give me the ingredients?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It’s been a long time since I made medicine with these ingredients. At that time, it was for the child who was by Shinick's side... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please wait a moment. It won't take long. I'll serve you some tea while you wait. Now, here… .
(Mediah hands over the tea and focuses on making the medicine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's that car from before. I remember it because it smelled good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad it fits your taste.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Okay, that's it. Feed this to Shinik. He won't die in this situation... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No, you can't die. Still, there will be some stability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wait a minute… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is there anything you want to ask me? It looks like you've met Vice... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have the power needed for the god you serve, but you seem to be hesitating... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if I wanted to, I don't think it would be right away. Medea also said this. Come visit often so you can trust me.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go now. I won't stop you from visiting, so I'll assume you'll come back later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. I'll go. Medea.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, %s, I saw someone following him as he left. I don't know what's going on, so I'll report it first.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Baynon, you don't have to worry about that. Because they are fulfilling their mission in their own way.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, I understand. It must be because Medea says so. But I left a bunch of these boxes behind. It looks like food… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come to think of it, thanks to %s, Baynon's tone of voice has changed. Of course, in a good way.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, this is cake… Okay. It’s been a while since I last saw you. And there are cards… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: “Congratulations on Medea’s birthday. - Hmong Hmong Guild」

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: How do you know my birthday... . Ah, it would be possible if it were that person from another continent.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, how many candles should I put in? I think you'll have to plug in a lot first... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess I should take back the compliment. A person without any sense... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Huh, sorry.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay. Please call the villagers instead. We all have to eat delicious food together.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik… , please overcome it.

steps.name: Girl's Memories (5)
steps.objective: After talking with [Melvik] in the “Underground City of Tartarus,” go to [Shainic].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: %s, you are here. I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You're a little more stable now, but I'm still a little anxious. I think this ribbon touched something in Shinik’s heart… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought the medicine that Medea made. here… .

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you. Then give Shinik some medicine... .
(Melvik gives medicine to Shinick. Shinik’s face, which had been drooping and drooping, becomes brighter.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ha! I almost died!!

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Huh? Do you think I might die?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seeing as how he can make jokes like that, he seems to be sane... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, why are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He said that he explained the situation to Medea and received medicine from Shinik.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If it's that medicine, it's the medicine I gave him before when I saved Melvik. Did it work for me too?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Ah, that was the medicine that Shinik took at that time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. that's right. By the way, he sent it to me to tell me what I would do if I woke up decades later like Melbig.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you always. For allowing me to be here... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's it. Because I didn’t save you just to hear that story. By the way, I'm going to say thank you to Medea and go hang out later♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shinik, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvik, I'm fine. I'm fine. Where's the ribbon? Ah, here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. I should be okay. Now let me tell you my story. %s… . Do you want to listen to Melvic too?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm fine. I still have something to talk about with Noel about something related to the top.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay. Then %s, follow me. I'll tell you what you want to know from my place♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's just as you might guess, but... . So shall we begin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: There was a very small village on one side of the Kingdom of Jude, located in the desert. Latinx Village, the name of my hometown.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: At that time, the Deimos Church expanded its power and attacked the village, but fortunately, a certain wizard fought back and there was not much damage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This is Ixion, whom I cursed and hated so much.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion, the archmage of the Kingdom of Jude. In the eyes of the children, he was a hero. So the children followed Ixion and wanted to become wizards.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion told the children that they, too, could become wizards, and received permission from their parents to take these children and turn them into great wizards.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Among them were me and Eda. The children probably thought they too would become wizards in Jude Kingdom. Obviously… . but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're having a hard time, you don't have to talk about it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's okay. Then keep listening. Let’s see… . Oh, the children followed Ixion to Moros and began learning magic in a place called a bomb shelter.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But, something was different. Some force was injected, but I didn't suspect it. Because it was just something magical and magical... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It was fun to be with my friends, and I believed that I could protect people by defeating the fanatics of the Deimos Church with that magic in the Dark War.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought it was simply like that. However, I realized after some time that something was wrong.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: More strange power was injected, and strange things began to appear in the bodies of the children who could not bear it. Other than human form... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I didn't have that though, but it still had side effects.  The reason I didn’t grow up, the reason I didn’t die… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I had to go to the battlefield and kill someone against my will... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When I came to my senses, there was a weapon covered in tens of thousands of blood. From then on, I realized. That I can no longer go back to my old self.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Still, I thought it could stop once the Dark War ended. However, as Ixion begins to dispose of the useless children... .
(Shainik’s eyes waver.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought I would be able to return to my hometown after the war... . While Ixion was briefly unshackled, he ran away with the children... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ixion's power once again bound us and caused us to run wild. At that moment, I realized. Everything will end only if Ixion is killed... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But, I was out of my mind at the time and had to survive. I thought I was the only one who survived there... . Eda was alive... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eda loved flowers and trees and loved decorating things with them. Making clothes... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A little early… . I should have found out a little sooner... . I should have gone a little earlier.
(Tears form around Shineek’s eyes and then fall.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. Then listen to my story more. Even if you don’t like it, I’ll keep talking about it♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought everything would be over when I returned to my hometown, but while I couldn't go there because of the war, my hometown disappeared?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But thanks to you, I built such a wonderful city, caught the people who came to kill me, and put them in the abyss... . Ixion, who came to kill me, is also thrown in here... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You did the finishing touches, but it's okay now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why are you so sad? Because I'm fine. Phew, this is the first time we've talked about something like this since Melbig and Mediah.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Even if I feel like killing you in the future, I won’t kill you♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Let me tell you another thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What else is left?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Originally I wasn't going to tell you... . hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Do you want to know that? Then keep bringing me fun stuff until I can trust you♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute, I don’t think that’s Shinik’s line….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. I don’t think I’ll have any time left even if I die now♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Shinik. Please don't make jokes like that. Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, okay. I won't do that. thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, I'll go now. Get some rest today.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need to make another tombstone... . Welcome, Eda… . This is the hometown I wanted to come to so much... . Cluck, cluck… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ah… , why didn't I realize it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: … It was the power of restraint that made me and Eda like this... .
